'''Atton's ribbed jacket''' was the personal property of [[Atton Rand]], one of the [[Lost Jedi]] and companion of the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], at the time of his incarceration at the [[Peragus Mining Facility]] and his only means of protection during the [[Skirmish at Peragus II]]. A durable jacket, it was comparable to light armor and protected its owner from a variety of hazards.

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only the playable character Atton Rand can equip this article of clothing.
